subject: Worth a quick look if you are building Audio/ Voice AI
text:

useful.

subject: Scaling Data Pipelines
text:
Hi [NAME],

Noticed you're growing your AI engineering team to accelerate model
development and thought Encord might be relevant.

We're an ML Ops platform that helps robotics teams scale data pipelines, so
you can focus on model iteration rather than data cleaning & annotation.

We work with over 200 AI teams such as Woven (Toyota), Zipline & PI, and

you scale - are you open to learning more?

subject: UMV mini - LiDAR sensors
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw RAI's recent blog post on the progress you made on the UMV mini and
incorporating LiDAR (alongside other hardware) for motion planning and
navigation. Given your background in 3D algos, thought I'd reach out.

I'm working with our robotics partners in the space, including teams like
Boston Dynamics, Pickle Robot, and ADAS teams including Woven by Toyota, on
robotics data collection, multimodal annotation/VLA captioning, and policy
evaluation in deployments.

I know your future work in [YEAR] will involve more sophisticated learning
algorithms and larger, more diverse datasets, so keen to get your feedback
on what we've built to solve those problems - worst case, we'd exchange
perspectives from our work across domain-specific and general-purpose
robotics teams.

Would you have 15/20 mins this week to swap notes? Weds/Thurs works well
for me.

subject: Scaling ML Pipelines
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've been following what [COMPANY] is doing with conversational
intelligence - building reliable ML on messy, real-world audio is one of
the harder problems in voice AI right now.

As model iterations speed up, the bottleneck shifts to evaluating whether
the new version actually improves across edge cases - overlapping speakers,
low-confidence transcriptions. Comparing outputs side by side at scale is a
real pain.

That's the core problem we solve at Encord. Leading AI teams such as
Synthesia and Twelve Labs use us to cut audio review cycles and catch
regressions before they ship.

Worth an intro call to see if this maps to what you're running into?

subject: [NAME] - BOLO
text:
Hi 
        [NAME], 

        Congrats on the BOLO/POI launch, very timely given what hospitals are dealing with now - real-time identification can be a big game changer compared to manual logs. 

       Reaching out as I work with teams building high-stakes computer vision and identity systems (e.g. LiveViewTech, Flock Safety, Rhombus).        If useful, I'd love to grab 20 mins to say hello, learn more about your focus for [YEAR], and share a few patterns we're seeing across similar teams. 

       Happy to keep it informal - would you have 20 mins this Thursday or Friday?
